scenes.title: Free apps. $64.6B.
scenes.sub: What Instagram's owner made in 3 months.

lines.say: Instagram is free. So how did Meta bring in sixty four point six billion dollars in three months?
lines.show: Instagram is free. So how did Meta bring in $64.6 billion in three months?

lines.say: Ads. Ninety seven point six percent of it came from ads.
lines.show: Ads. 97.6% of it came from ads.

lines.say: Three point six four billion people use its apps every day.
lines.show: 3.64 billion people use its apps every day.

lines.say: Meta showed ten percent more ads, and charged fourteen percent more for each one.
lines.show: Meta showed 10% more ads, and charged 14% more for each one.

lines.say: Ad revenue jumped twenty six percent.

scenes.label: per daily user
scenes.note: In one quarter. HFLIC math: $64.6B ÷ 3.64B people

lines.say: That's roughly seventeen seventy five in revenue for every daily user, in one quarter.
lines.show: That's roughly $17.75 in revenue for every daily user, in one quarter.

scenes.label: in capital spending
scenes.note: Buildings and equipment, July to Sept. 2026

lines.say: And it spent thirty four point nine billion dollars on buildings and equipment in those same three months.
lines.show: And it spent $34.9 billion on buildings and equipment in those same three months.

scenes.label: lost in 3 months
scenes.note: Meta's VR headset and smart glasses unit

lines.say: Meanwhile, its headset and smart glasses unit lost four point one billion dollars.
lines.show: Meanwhile, its headset and smart glasses unit lost $4.1 billion.

scenes.takeaway: Free app? Ads pay the bills.
scenes.source: Data: Meta Q3 2026 earnings release, Oct. 21, 2026

lines.say: Follow H Flick for more money facts like this.
lines.show: Follow HFLIC for more money facts like this.

lines.show: And send this to the friend who's on Instagram all day.
